title: Reported speech
recall: Reported speech'da zamonlar qanday o'zgaradi? say va tell farqi? Savol va buyruqni qanday ko'chirasiz?
formula: zamon bir qadam orqaga: am → was, will → would, have done → had done, did → had done
say (something) / tell + KIMGA: He said that… / He told me that…
savol: asked if / where + oddiy tartib; buyruq: told me to / not to; admit, deny, suggest, refuse, warn

en: He said he was tired.
He said that he was tired.
She said she was tired.
He told me he would be late.
He told me that he would be late.
She told me she would be late.
She asked me where I lived.
He asked me where I lived.

items.uz: U mendan ingliz tilini bilishimni so'radi.
en: He asked me if I spoke English.
She asked me whether I spoke English.
He asked if I spoke English.
He told me to close the door.
She told me to close the door.
She told me not to be late.
He told me not to be late.
He said he had seen that film.
She said that she had seen that movie.
He said he would come the next day.
She said she would come the following day.
He said he would come tomorrow.

items.uz: U xatoga yo'l qo'yganini tan oldi.
en: He admitted making a mistake.
He admitted that he had made a mistake.
She admitted making a mistake.
He denied taking the money.
She denied taking the money.
He denied that he had taken the money.
She suggested going to the cinema.
He suggested going to the cinema.
She suggested that we go to the cinema.
He refused to help.
She refused to help me.
He refused to help me.

items.uz: U meni u yerga bormaslik haqida ogohlantirdi.
en: She warned me not to go there.
He warned me not to go there.
He asked me when I had arrived.
She asked when I had arrived.
He asked me when I arrived.
They said they were going to get married.
They said that they were getting married.
She told me she loved me.
He told me he loved me.

items.uz: U menga ertaroq kelishga va'da berdi.
en: He promised to come earlier.
She promised to come early.
He promised me he would come earlier.
She said she worked here.
He said that he worked here.
She said she worked there.

items.uz: O'qituvchi bizdan uy vazifasini qilganimizni so'radi.
en: The teacher asked us if we had done our homework.
The teacher asked whether we had done our homework.
He apologised to me.
She apologized to me.
He said sorry to me.

speak: Kecha kimdir sizga nima dedi? 5 ta gapni reported speech'da ayting.
Oxirgi yig'ilishda kim nima taklif qildi, nimani rad etdi?
Sizga berilgan 3 ta savolni ko'chiring (asked if / where).
